answer: Each voyage keeps weight in the vault only by renewing: its weight halves every epoch unless it submits a judged task and burns ocean. The vault compares each submission with all others, and a voyage whose answers correlate with k others pays 2^k ocean to renew, so n near-identical clones pay exponentially every epoch, forever, and true divergence needs n independent models doing real work. Idle clone stockpiles simply evaporate. It breaks if cheap paraphrasing fools the correlation test.
